name: imrodmartin/jarvis-install-recipe
description: Drupal recipe that adds the Jarvis theme to a site that ALREADY has its own config: the theme, Drupal Canvas with folders/patterns/templates, the jarvis_* media type, image styles and text formats. Namespaced throughout and non-strict, so your existing config is never overwritten. Unlike imrodmartin/jarvis-recipe it installs no demo content and takes over nothing - it does not switch your default theme, admin theme or front page.
